compatibility: MultiRocket ridge-only adapter removes unused torch logistic import and obsolete normalize=False. Feature-generating code unchanged. SelF-Rocket code unmodified; warnings reset to visible after import.
standard_recipes: MultiRocket default requested 50000, actual 49728; author RidgeClassifierCV alpha grid
SelF-Rocket default 10 runs, 5000 sampled features per mini-classifier, all 15 IR/PO candidates; selected final dimension 9996 or 19992; internal generated dimension 99960
controlled_recipe: MultiRocket and EI both actual 9408 features; whole transform and scaler refit inside grouped/stratified 3-fold training CV; alpha grid .1,1,10,100,1000. MultiRocket requested10000 produces9408 due 8-way feature allocation. No default50k baseline is replaced by this budget control.
standard_validation_caveat: Author recipes preserve internal training-only selection, including feature calibration/scaling before internal validation. No test data enters fitting. These recipes are not labeled fold-local strict CV; MPEG duplicate groups are not implemented inside untouched author recipes.

stability.design: Five stratified random resplits of pooled existing sources, preserving approximate source train proportion; one random assignment per exact-duplicate group across raw/32/64 representations; all views of an object remain on one side. Not new unseen data. Whole feature transform/scaler refit in every inner fold. Repeated splits overlap and are not independent datasets.

high_k: Fixed EI-trained classifier; evaluate K16/32/64/128 feature error, score error, prediction agreement and matched timings. No tuning of K on test labels. No assertion of equivalence from nonsignificance.
analysis: Report source-specific effects. Object-paired intervals for original split are descriptive. Repeated-split ranges/SD and win counts are descriptive, not an independent n=5 significance test.
scope: Follow-up on previously inspected sources. No untouched test source or fixed-pose repeated acquisition is claimed.
